verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the external_directory permission, which lets tool calls reach paths outside the directory where OpenCode was started. That means an agent can touch other directories during a session, but the docs describe this only as a permission gate, not as a feature for adding multiple project roots as context. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-root or multi-project workspace feature, documentation on adding extra directories to session context (indexing, LSP, instructions), and hands-on corroboration.
